mechanism: Encode a validated sequence of Metal compute stages once into a compute indirect command buffer, retain ICB-capable pipelines and stable buffer addresses, declare indirect resources explicitly at replay, and execute the sequence through one direct compute encoder in the existing one-submit TokenCommandBuffer.

scope.purpose: Replayability substrate required by the Temporal Gravity objective; not a revival of ICB as a throughput lever.

construction_contract.persistent_scalar_arguments: All captured arguments are MTLBuffer bindings; set_bytes payloads are not admitted.
construction_contract.icb_pipeline_requirement: Every captured pipeline is compiled with supportIndirectCommandBuffers=true and retained for the graph lifetime.
construction_contract.resource_residency: Each unique captured buffer is declared on the direct compute encoder with the union of its read/write usage.
construction_contract.dependency_ordering: A stage may set barrier_before; dependent stages must use it.
construction_contract.context_binding: Replay fails closed when the graph and TokenCommandBuffer do not share the same MetalContext.
construction_contract.trace_policy: Off and aggregate CPU-encode modes are admitted; split/per-dispatch GPU trace modes fail closed because they cannot attribute commands inside the ICB.

performed_before_icb_allocation: at least one persistent buffer binding per stage
buffer indices in Metal range and unique within each stage
kernel resolution and ICB-capable pipeline creation
threadgroup size within the compiled pipeline maximum
fail_closed_validation.negative_fixture: gravity_zero_f32 with a zero grid dimension

qualified: A bounded compute graph can be encoded once and replayed repeatedly through one physical command buffer and one direct encoder while retaining exact outputs and stable buffer addresses.
The graph integrates with TokenCommandBuffer dispatch accounting, cost-ledger stage accounting, physical labels, and aggregate CPU-encode tracing.
Invalid graph geometry, bindings, context ownership, and incompatible trace modes fail closed.
not_qualified: No production decode path selects this graph.
No end-to-end latency or throughput improvement is claimed; existing repository evidence keeps ICB below the performance ship gate.
No sealed Math-Preserve token, sustained 2K/8K/32K run, memory-pressure run, swap observation, or thermal promotion was performed.
The full token forward graph has not yet been captured.
qualification.next_boundary: Capture a bounded complete-token DAG only after its persistent scalar buffers, dependency barriers, and profiler attribution are enumerated; keep selection default-off and require parity before any production admission.
